content.content: 1. Necessity: the prose leaves the untracked set unsettled in a way only a machine-checked ignore file can settle. Fail if the ignore file could be dropped without loss. 2. Fidelity: stage a target/ tree and an _apalache-out/ tree and run `jj status`. Fail if any build or model-checker output is tracked, or any node file, schema, or manifest is ignored — name the diverging path.
content.rationale: The ignore file is where build output meets versioned state; the gate forces the untracked set to match exactly what was decided, in both directions.
